GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 130 (13 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 432)
APO 500
13 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office
SUBJECT : Government Borrowing
1. Reference is made to the two memoranda of the Minister of Finance, dated 5 and 3 December 1945 (LOF 37 and LOF 40), requesting approval of borrowing by the Japanese Imperial Government for the purchase of food, charcoal and firewood for resale to consumers.
2. Permission is granted to borrow ¥1, 500,000, 000 for the purchase of rice, and ¥75,000,000 for the purchase of charcoal and firewood, as requested in those memoranda.
3. Acknowledgement of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
